# Harry Bone Drum Lessons

> Professional drum lessons in Bristol, UK with Harry Bone — BMus (Hons) from the Royal Welsh College of Music & Drama, 20+ years playing, 6+ years teaching. In-person at a home studio in Bristol (BS14) or mobile (Harry comes to you), plus online lessons across the UK. All ages and levels, beginner to advanced, including Rockschool/exam prep. DBS checked. Trial lesson £10; lessons £10–£40.

## Start here

- [Harry Bone Drum Lessons home](https://harrybonedrumlessons.com): Lessons offered, pricing, location, and how to book.

## What's offered

- Private drum lessons in Bristol — in-person at the home studio (Bristol BS14) or mobile (Harry travels to you).
- Online drum lessons across the UK.
- All ages and levels: children and adults, complete beginners through advanced; Rockschool and exam preparation available.
- Taught by a BMus (Hons) graduate, DBS checked.

## Booking and contact

- Trial lesson: £10. Regular lessons: £10–£40.
- Email: harrybonedrumlessons@gmail.com
- Phone / WhatsApp: +44 7984 263112
- Location: Bristol, UK (BS14 8HT) — in-person, mobile, and online.
